name: Moody
role: Cowboy and lariat artist (Moody and Sankey)
bio: Items under the name Moody appear to cover more than one man: Moody of the 'Big Foot' Ryder outfit, cutting posts in March 1884, and a party to a Moody-Malloy case tried at Dickinson in May 1884. The most-reported was Moody of the cowboy pair Moody and Sankey, skilled with the lariat, who left in May 1884 with a touring show outfit of Crow men, cowboys and wild broncos and returned to Medora in August after an engagement with the Rocky Mountain show.
